text_block_list.text: Whoa! That race was so fun!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
The energy of the crowd! Everyone
racing at full
speed!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Just that is enough to make me happy,
but seeing
my name on the scoreboard is
like... whoa!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I just know if I'd been in first place, I'd
be even
happier right now!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Okay! Then I'll just be happy!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: Yaaaay! I got a great result!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text: All right, then I gotta go louder!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
I mean, if I were to get first in a fun race
like the
one we just had...
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
It'd make me happier than anything—I
know it
would!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
choice_data_list: We'll work hard for it until it's yours!

text_block_list.text:
I'll train lots and lots and go even harder
than I
did today!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит

text_block_list.text:
Then next time... I'll get that first place!
Wooo!
text_block_list.name: Уиннинг Тикит
